ROOFS UP THE HILL AND THE LITTLE TOWER: tiled roofs climbing away behind the wall in uneven jumps, each one a different flat colour of rust and blue and warm ochre, the highest of them carrying a slim tower with a tiled hat on top, the whole band running out of frame on both sides

THE TALL TOWER OFF TO ONE SIDE: a slim tower rising well off to the left above every roofline, its tiled cone hat sitting slightly crooked on top, the other roofs stepping and jutting unevenly below it in chunky flat bands of terracotta and green

A HUNDRED CHIMNEYS STRAIGHT UP: a hundred chimneys standing above the parapet with their smoke going straight up in still cold air, the warm light catching the underside of each pale plume, the roofline stepping and jutting unevenly behind them

THE KITE OVER THE GABLES: steep gables crowding up behind the wall in a band of flat rust and jade and honey colours, and one paper kite up on a long string high over them all, its tail looping sideways in chunky pixel steps

THE FAT GREEN DOME: a fat dome in green copper rising above the roofline well off centre, its chunky stepped sides catching the light in three flat dithered bands, the roofs around it lower and uneven, running out of frame on both sides

SMOKE ALL LEANING ONE WAY: a long roofline stepping and jutting unevenly behind the wall, every chimney sending its smoke leaning the same direction in flat drifting bands, the whole pale mass tilting off to the right and out of frame

WALLS BEHIND WALLS WITH TOWERS: the tops of a second and a third wall stepping up behind the first, each band a paler flat colour than the one in front, a squat tower on the second and a taller one on the third, both of different heights

THE WINDMILL SAILS OVER THE PARAPET: the tips of four great windmill sails just showing above the parapet on the right side of the frame, turning in chunky pixel steps, the roofline beside them low and uneven in flat bands of terracotta and grey

THE ROOFTOP GARDEN AND THE FIGURE: a flat roof showing above the wall carrying clay pots of different heights and a small figure standing side-on among them, the roofline stepping unevenly around it in flat colours of rust and blue and warm stone

THE GREAT TREE ABOVE EVERYTHING: a great tree rising taller than every roof behind the wall, its canopy spreading in chunky flat blocks of deep green, the roofline below it stepping and jutting unevenly in bands of ochre and rust running out of frame

A FAT PLUME PAST A TOWER: one fat chimney well off to the right sending a thick pale plume straight up past a squat tower, the rest of the roofline low and uneven behind the wall, a dozen thinner plumes standing beside the big one

THE AQUEDUCT CROSSING BEHIND THE ROOFS: a stone aqueduct crossing behind the roofline in chunky flat bands of pale honey stone, its arches stepping unevenly, running out of the right edge of the frame, the roofs below it in flat rust and jade

SECOND AND THIRD WALLS IN PALE STEPS: the tops of two more walls stepping up behind the first in receding bands, each one a flatter paler colour, the nearest a warm grey and the farthest almost white, a small tower on each at different positions

THE DOVECOTE ON THE RIDGE: a tall dovecote sitting on a ridge above the parapet with birds going in and out of its round holes in chunky pixel steps, the roofline around it stepping unevenly in flat terracotta and blue and warm ochre

WASHING BETWEEN THE UPPER WINDOWS: two upper windows on a tall flat block showing above the wall with a line of washing strung between them in flat blocks of colour, red and yellow and pale blue, the roofline beside it stepping unevenly

THE WATERWHEEL TURNING: a tall waterwheel turning against a wall behind the gate, its chunky stepped paddles catching the light, the splash at its foot rendered as blocky pixel spray, the roofline on either side stepping unevenly in flat rust and stone

THE FLOCK TURNING OVER ONE GABLE: a steep gable showing above the wall on the left with a flock of birds turning all together over it in a loose pixel cluster, the roofline beside it stepping down in uneven jumps of flat terracotta and grey

ROOFS CLIMBING IN UNEVEN COLOUR JUMPS: tiled roofs stepping away behind the wall, each one a different flat colour, deep rust then pale jade then warm yellow, the jumps between them uneven, the highest roof carrying a slim round tower with a cone on top

PAPER LANTERNS RISING: a scatter of small round paper lanterns rising above the roofline in a loose drifting cluster, each one a different flat colour, the roofs below them stepping and jutting unevenly in bands of ochre and terracotta running out of frame

A LONG ROW OF WHITE BIRDS ON THE RIDGE: a long ridge showing above the parapet with a row of white birds settled all along it in chunky pixel silhouettes, the roofline around it stepping down unevenly in flat terracotta and warm grey on both sides

THE BIG NEST ON THE CHIMNEY: a wide flat nest of sticks sitting on top of a broad chimney showing above the wall, a long-legged bird standing upright in it, the roofline around it stepping and jutting unevenly in flat rust and jade and stone

BEEHIVES ON THE FLAT ROOF: a flat roof showing above the parapet carrying a row of five beehives in chunky stepped pixel shapes, each a slightly different size, the roofline beside it stepping unevenly in bands of warm ochre and terracotta running out of frame

SMOKE LEANING PAST A SLIM TOWER: a slim tower standing above the roofline well off centre with smoke from chimneys around it all leaning the same way, the pale drifting mass passing the tower in flat bands, the roofline below stepping and jutting unevenly

THREE WALLS AND THEIR TOWERS IN PALE BANDS: three walls showing in receding steps behind the gate, the nearest in warm honey stone, the middle in pale grey, the farthest almost white, a tower on each at a different position, each tower a different height

ROOFS UP THE HILL WITH A TOP TOWER: tiled roofs stepping up behind the wall in uneven colour jumps of rust and blue and pale green, each one a different height, the highest carrying a small round tower with a cone hat, the band running out of frame both sides
